create_imagenet_train_transforms: create an ImageNet training transform pipeline with random crop, flip, color jitter, and normalization
build_random_resized_crop: build a random resized crop transform that crops to random size and aspect ratio then resizes
apply_color_jitter: apply brightness, contrast, and saturation jitter to BGR tensor images with configurable variance
perform_lighting_jitter: perform AlexNet-style PCA lighting jitter on images using eigenvalues and eigenvectors
create_random_augment: create a RandAugment video transform with configurable magnitude and number of operations
